parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original opaque square repeatable ground MATERIAL master for Synthetic Ascension, not an isolated sprite, patch, swatch photograph or environment scene.
Primary request: TENDED SHORT LAWN for modest medieval European homes. A continuous full-frame plane of short fine irregular grass blades with gentle organic wear/thinning, small soft interwoven hints of neutral earth, and restrained broad variation. It looks cut, grazed or cared for by residents, rather than lush modern sports turf or tall neglected undergrowth. No distinctive plant heads or dominant unique feature.
Projection: perfectly flat strictly overhead orthographic top view. Material fills every pixel edge-to-edge. Opposite left/right and top/bottom edges must continue naturally for repeated tiling, with matching average value and texture at the borders; no framed patch or center composition. Square high-resolution master.
Rendering/style: quiet painterly game terrain, broad understated color/value groups with fine blade texture suggested within them, subordinate to actors and buildings. Temperate muted middle-dark grey-olive green, subtle straw/earth touches, restrained saturation. Shared daylight/value/texel density with a matching low olive/brown-green damp moss-and-soil ground material: naturally subdued and evenly exposed, not vivid emerald, blue/cyan/purple or a bright yellow lawn. Aim near an understated olive-green average, approximately RGB70/81/53, with gentle variation rather than a single flat fill. Flat even ambient albedo illumination, NO baked directional lighting gradient or cast shadows.
Context personally inspected: accepted08 Mediterranean-medieval-industrial city for setting, current ground_grass_01 and dry grass/dirt/mud for material family and scale, ground_grass_02 only as neglected undergrowth to avoid, rejected cyan/purple broad-leaf ground_moss_01 and native S7 exterior only as negative context. These are context, NOT edit targets. New original source.
Texel/scale intent: one repeat will initially be assessed around320 world pixels across (five64px cells). Individual short blades should be fine and mostly merge into quiet soft tufts at that scale; do not paint huge crisp clover/fern rosettes or a dense carpet of outlined leaves. Keep the same fine feature scale as a low moss/soil partner.
Avoid modern mower stripes, checker patterns, perfect turf rectangles, radial clusters, tall weeds, large leaves, ferns, flowers, visible rocks/props, paths, borders, lawn-island silhouettes, perimeter wear rings, round patch boundaries, dramatic cracks, symbols, focal motifs, vignette, corner darkening, cast shadows, highlights/glow, perspective or any surrounding scenery. No transparency: fully opaque rectangular surface, no alpha holes, no border/text/watermark. Production will blend irregular plot edges; DO NOT encode patch edges in the texture.

parameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original OPAQUE SQUARE repeatable ground MATERIAL master for Synthetic Ascension. Flat top-down terrain texture, not a scene or transparent island.
Primary request: LOW NATURAL GREEN MOSS AND DAMP SOIL for sheltered temperate European canal/underpass ground. Fine low olive and brown-green moss interweaves softly across modest neutral grey-brown damp soil and a little very small subdued stony grit. Quiet organic transitions within a continuous surface; neither dense broad-leaf vegetation nor bare cracked mud. Fine moss is compressed close to the ground, not big fern/clover leaf shapes or visible floral rosettes. Slight dampness expressed by darker neutral earth, without shiny water, streams or puddle scenes.
Strictly overhead orthographic flat plane, fills the entire image edge-to-edge, square source. Opposite edges should continue naturally in both axes for repeat tiling, with matching average value and texture; no border, center-weighted composition, patch perimeter, isolated turf island or fading edges. Production owns irregular moss/soil blending boundaries.
Shared scale/value requirement: match the cared short lawn material just generated in this conversation as a quiet fine-scale ground family. The lawn is style/value/feature-density context, not an edit target. Use muted middle-dark grey-olive/brown-green, softly interleaved neutral soil. Average brightness should be comparable to the lawn, perhaps modestly earthier, never a radically lighter/darker spot. Restrained saturation, broad low-contrast variation and selective fine moss/grit detail. One tile is initially assessed around320 world pixels across, five64px cells, so fine details should merge into calm surface texture at game size.
Painterly game-material rendering consistent with accepted08 Mediterranean-medieval-industrial city, simplified and subordinate to actors and buildings. Even ambient daylight albedo exposure across the entire image, NO baked directional lighting, corner darkening, vignette, dramatic shadow, cast shadows or bright highlights.
Personally viewed context: current ground_grass_01/dry and ground_dirt_01/ground_mud_wet_01 for scale and subdued material family; ground_grass_02 is only neglected undergrowth; rejected ground_moss_01 and native S7 exterior are NEGATIVE examples. DO NOT imitate their cyan/blue/purple dense broad-leaf carpet. New original source, no edit targets.
Explicitly avoid blue, cyan, teal or purple foliage/soil; large leaves, fern fronds, flowers, thick leafy carpets, magical glow, fungal patterns, moss balls, paths, props, rocks larger than tiny grit, masonry bricks, dramatic cracks, radial/star motifs, distinctive repeating focal feature, landscape, wall, canal/stream depiction, water puddle shapes, shadows, gradient, texture borders, text, watermark or checkerboard. Fully opaque background, no alpha or transparent holes.
